title: A compact, neutral Python editor layout
summary: Replaced stacked green controls with a single app bar, an environment dropdown, underline tabs and a unified editor panel.

changes.detail: Consolidated runtime selection, PC Python mode and closing into one compact app bar. Removed the separate runtime button row and advanced-mode banner.
Introduced neutral gray light/dark surfaces, underline panel tabs, smaller editor font, restrained green actions, an integrated filename bar and desktop content width cap.
Repaired corrupted Arabic and French secondary labels and kept filename/count/code direction LTR. Added Arabic label assertions to the existing interaction test.
Default workspace uses light theme unless the saved preference explicitly selects dark; editor height adapts to the viewport.

validation.name: Validation
validation.detail: Pending build, typecheck, lint and interaction tests. Browser visual verification unavailable because browser inventory is empty; native device verification not performed.
